fields.name: change
fields.description: A text from the admin that describes the change, for example `"cx"`. It is `""` when the admin gives none.

confirm.note: `change` is whatever the admin passes (`change || ""`), not checked.

senders.what: `reload_server(to_broadcast, change)` with a true `to_broadcast`, after it loads the design files and builds `G` and `D` again. No handler calls it: an admin runs it through `servers_eval` (design/cosmetics.js:195).
